description: React component for enabling two-factor authentication via a modal dialog, including setup steps, API interactions, and UI rendering.

classes.name: WithStep
classes.description: Conditional rendering component that displays children if the current step matches the specified step.

methods.name: resetState
methods.description: Resets form state to initial values and step to ConfirmPassword.

methods.name: handleSetup
methods.description: Handles the setup process for enabling 2FA, including API call and state updates.

methods.name: handleEnable
methods.description: Handles enabling 2FA with the provided TOTP code, including API call and error handling.

methods.name: formatBackupCode
methods.description: Formats a backup code by inserting a hyphen in the middle.
